name: ncspot Keepalive
author: idrewlong
description: Keeps an ncspot (Spotify TUI client) session alive in the background via tmux, so Omarchy's built-in Media (MPRIS) bar widget can show now-playing and controls. Workaround for Spotify's official Linux client having no aarch64 build.

barWidget.description: Opens the ncspot TUI in a terminal, attaching the keepalive session
